title: Anthropic — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: Anthropic is a US frontier AI lab focused on AI safety and interpretability. Its Claude model family emphasizes constitutional AI, harmlessness, and long-context reasoning. Governance posture: strong published safety framework, responsible scaling policy, and third-party evaluations. Evidence confidence: high. Key strengths include alignment research, mechanistic interpretability, and tool-use reliability. Risks: rapid capability scaling ahead of governance maturity across the sector.

title: OpenAI — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: OpenAI is a US frontier AI lab. Its GPT model family leads on broad capability benchmarks, multimodal reasoning, and developer ecosystem. Governance posture: preparedness framework and red-teaming, though transparency of training data and evaluations is contested. Evidence confidence: high. Strengths: reasoning, code generation, agentic tool use. Risks: opacity around provenance and evaluation methodology; commercial pressure on release cadence.

title: Google DeepMind — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: Google DeepMind is a US/UK frontier lab. The Gemini model family integrates multimodal reasoning with Google infrastructure and scientific research (AlphaFold lineage). Governance posture: frontier safety framework and internal review boards. Evidence confidence: high. Strengths: scientific reasoning, multimodality, retrieval integration. Risks: productization pressure and integration complexity across a large organization.

title: SocioProphet — Sovereign Verified-Compute Dossier
body: SocioProphet is a sovereign platform whose differentiation is proof-carrying, ontology-driven, graph-native compute. Rather than a single frontier model, its moat is verified compute: every result carries provenance and epistemic warrant, grounded in the HellGraph knowledge graph. Governance posture: proof-carrying receipts, capability membrane, and epistemic typing. Evidence confidence: high. Strengths: sovereignty, provenance, ontology reasoning, agent-native retrieval. Risks: ecosystem maturity versus incumbents.

title: DeepSeek — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: DeepSeek is a Chinese lab releasing strong open-weight models with efficient training. Its models compete on reasoning and code at a fraction of typical training cost. Governance posture: limited published safety framework; open-weight distribution raises misuse considerations. Evidence confidence: medium. Strengths: cost-efficient training, open weights, reasoning. Risks: provenance transparency and jurisdictional governance.

title: Meta AI — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: Meta AI releases the Llama open-weight model family, catalyzing an open ecosystem of fine-tunes and tools. Governance posture: acceptable-use policy and open release with safeguards. Evidence confidence: medium. Strengths: open weights, ecosystem, efficiency. Risks: downstream misuse of open weights and inconsistent evaluation across derivatives.

title: Mistral — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: Mistral is an EU lab producing efficient open-weight and commercial models with strong European data-sovereignty positioning. Governance posture: EU AI Act alignment and enterprise controls. Evidence confidence: medium. Strengths: efficiency, sovereignty in the EU, licensing flexibility. Risks: scale relative to US frontier labs.

title: xAI — Frontier Lab Dossier
body: xAI is a US lab whose Grok model family emphasizes real-time data and integration with a large social platform. Governance posture: emerging safety framework. Evidence confidence: medium. Strengths: real-time retrieval, rapid iteration. Risks: governance maturity and evaluation transparency.

title: Claude — Model Family Scorecard
body: Claude is Anthropic's model family. Scorecard: strong on long-context reasoning, tool use, harmlessness, and instruction following. Proof-of-alignment (POA) high; evidence-grounded assessment (EGA) high. Evidence confidence: high. Notable for constitutional training and reliable refusal behavior.

title: GPT — Model Family Scorecard
body: GPT is OpenAI's model family. Scorecard: leading broad capability, code generation, multimodal, and agentic tool use. POA high; EGA medium-high given evaluation opacity. Evidence confidence: high. Strong developer ecosystem and function-calling reliability.

title: Gemini — Model Family Scorecard
body: Gemini is Google DeepMind's model family. Scorecard: multimodal reasoning, scientific tasks, and retrieval integration. POA high; EGA high. Evidence confidence: high. Strong on long-context and grounding with search.

title: Llama — Model Family Scorecard
body: Llama is Meta's open-weight model family. Scorecard: strong efficiency and a vast fine-tune ecosystem. POA medium; EGA medium. Evidence confidence: medium. Open weights enable sovereign self-hosting and customization.
